name: 测试 定义 StorageUsage 领域对象
description:
为 StorageUsage DTO 编写单元测试：
1. 正常计算：used_bytes=100, quota_bytes=1000 → usage_percent=10
2. 满配额：used_bytes=1000, quota_bytes=1000 → usage_percent=100
3. 超配额：used_bytes=1500, quota_bytes=1000 → usage_percent=150
4. 零配额边界：quota_bytes=0 的处理
5. 向上取整：ceil(1*100/3)=34
产出物：tests/文件存储服务/models/storageusage_test.go
